about.title: About LuminaTech
about.subtitle: Professional stage lighting for concerts, weddings, clubs, and rental worldwide.
about.section1Body: LuminaTech specializes in stage lighting and live-event equipment. From lighting consoles to laser systems, moving heads, and effects — every product is vetted for DMX compatibility, output quality, and road-ready durability.
about.section2Body: Our catalog covers lighting consoles, laser systems, stage fixtures (moving heads, PAR cans, washes), effects (fog machines, strobes), and DMX accessories. All equipment includes official warranty and technical support.
about.section3Body: We ship to customers in the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, and many other regions. All orders include tracking, and we work with trusted logistics partners to ensure safe, timely delivery.
about.section4Body: Your trust matters. We use industry-standard encryption for payments (Stripe and PayPal), never store your card details on our servers, and offer hassle-free returns within 30 days on unused items.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026. This policy describes how LuminaTech collects, uses, stores, and shares personal data when you use our storefront. It is written for customers in the US, UK, and EU/EEA. It is not a substitute for formal legal counsel.
privacy.section1Body: LuminaTech operates this online store selling professional stage lighting and related equipment. For privacy requests, contact support@luminatech.com. If you appoint a local representative or DPO later, those details will be added here.
privacy.section2Body: Account data: email, optional name, and password hash. Order data: shipping address, phone, email, purchased items, amounts, and payment provider references (Stripe/PayPal IDs — we do not store full card numbers). Support messages you send us. Technical logs: IP address, user agent, and basic request metadata for security and debugging. Product reviews you submit.
privacy.section3Body: We use your data to process orders, calculate shipping/tax estimates, deliver digital downloads you purchased, send transactional email (order confirmation, shipping, password reset), prevent fraud/abuse, and improve the store. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.section4Body: We use essential cookies/local storage for cart contents, locale preference, checkout session helpers, and signed admin/customer sessions. These are required for the site to work. We do not currently run third-party advertising pixels. If analytics or ads are added later, we will update this policy and, where required, request consent.
privacy.section5Body: We rely on service providers such as hosting (e.g. Vercel), database (e.g. Neon/PostgreSQL), payments (Stripe and optionally PayPal), media delivery (e.g. Cloudinary), and email (SMTP provider). Data may be processed in the United States or other countries where these providers operate. Where GDPR/UK GDPR applies, transfers rely on the provider’s appropriate safeguards (such as SCCs).
privacy.section6Body: Order and invoice-related records are kept as long as needed for accounting, dispute handling, warranty support, and legal obligations. Account credentials remain until you ask us to delete the account (subject to outstanding orders). Password-reset tokens expire within about one hour. Server logs are retained for a limited operational period.
privacy.section7Body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export your personal data, restrict or object to certain processing, and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (for example an EU/EEA DPA or the UK ICO). Email support@luminatech.com with the subject “Privacy request”. We may need to verify your identity before acting.
privacy.section8Body: Privacy questions: support@luminatech.com. We aim to respond within a few business days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026. By browsing or purchasing from LuminaTech you agree to these Terms. Professional stage equipment may be subject to local safety, electrical, and laser regulations — you are responsible for lawful use.
terms.section1Body: You must be at least 18 years old (or the age of majority where you live) to place an order. You agree to provide accurate shipping and contact details. You are responsible for keeping account credentials confidential.
terms.section2Body: Catalog photos and descriptions are illustrative. Specs (power, weight, beam angle, DMX profiles, laser class, etc.) may change with firmware or manufacturer revisions. Stage lighting, lasers, and effects are intended for trained operators in suitable venues. You must follow manufacturer manuals, local electrical codes, venue rules, and laser safety requirements. We are not liable for misuse, improper rigging, or operation without required permits.
terms.section3Body: Prices are shown in USD unless stated otherwise. Checkout may estimate shipping and tax; the charged total is confirmed by the payment provider at payment time. We may cancel or refuse orders with obvious pricing/stock errors and will refund any amount captured in that case.
terms.section4Body: An order is accepted when payment succeeds and we confirm it (email and/or account order history). Primary payment is via Stripe (cards and enabled local methods). PayPal may be unavailable until fully enabled. Fraud checks may delay or cancel orders.
terms.section5Body: Delivery estimates are not guarantees. Heavy fixtures may ship via freight or require special handling; additional charges or schedule changes may apply and will be communicated when needed. Risk of loss generally passes when the carrier takes possession, subject to mandatory local consumer law. Always inspect packaging on arrival and report transit damage promptly with photos.
terms.section6Body: See our Returns Policy for the full process. In summary: unused items in original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery if eligible. Opened consumables, custom items, and certain clearance goods may be excluded. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after inspection.
terms.section7Body: Purchased firmware/files/plugins are licensed for your use with the related product and order. Redistribution, public upload, or resale of downloadable assets is prohibited. Download access may depend on order status remaining paid/non-cancelled.
terms.section8Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, LuminaTech is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages (including lost shows, rental income, or data). Our aggregate liability for a claim relating to a product is limited to the amount you paid for that product. Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations; in those places, our liability is limited to the minimum required by law. Contact: support@luminatech.com.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026. This policy explains how to return eligible stage equipment purchased from LuminaTech. Mandatory consumer rights in your country still apply.
returns.section1Body: You may request a return within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging with all accessories, manuals, and serial labels intact. The request date is when we receive your email with order number and photos if asked.
returns.section2Body: Eligible: unopened or carefully inspected unused fixtures/consoles/accessories that can be resold as new. Not eligible (unless defective on arrival): items damaged by misuse, missing parts, installed/racked gear with wear, custom-configured products, downloadable firmware/files once delivered, and consumables (fog fluid, etc.).
returns.section3Body: If a product arrives dead-on-arrival or has a manufacturing defect, contact us within 7 days of delivery with order number, serial number, and clear photos/video. We may offer replacement, repair coordination under warranty, or refund according to the case.
returns.section4Body: Email support@luminatech.com with subject “Return request”, your order number, item SKU(s), and reason. Do not ship anything back until we confirm the RMA/return authorization and address. Unauthorized returns may be refused or delayed.
returns.section5Body: Unless we confirm a defect attributable to us or carrier damage we accept, you are responsible for insured return shipping and any freight for heavy goods. We recommend using a trackable service. A restocking fee of up to 15% may apply for non-defective returns of heavy fixtures after inspection. Duties/taxes on cross-border returns may not be recoverable.
returns.section6Body: After we receive and inspect the return (typically 5–10 business days), approved refunds go back to the original payment method. Stripe refund timing then depends on your bank/card. Shipping fees are only refunded when required by law or when we caused the return (defect/wrong item).
returns.section7Body: Manufacturer warranty covers defects arising after acceptance under warranty terms and is separate from the 30-day returns window. Warranty service may require proof of purchase and may be handled via repair, replacement parts, or manufacturer channels.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you within 1–2 business days.
contact.section1Body: For order inquiries, returns, product questions, or technical support, email us at the address below. Please include your order number if applicable.
contact.section2Body: For wholesale, partnership, or press inquiries, please use the same contact email with your company details and we will route your message to the appropriate team.
